title: Ukanushaji (Theme 11: Mapato)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child changes the person prefix to its negative and the tense marker to its negative form (-na- drops and -a becomes -i; -li- becomes -ku-; -ta- stays).
representations: a table: ninasoma / sisomi, nilisoma / sikusoma, nitasoma / sitasoma
a positive and negative sentence pair
steps: Change the person to the negative.
Check the ending (-i in the present).

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Sichezi" and the negatives of "Nilicheza" and "Nitacheza".

misconceptions.repair: Wakati uliopo hukanushwa hivi: hasomi, si hanasoma.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Wanjiru alipika."" Kwa nini "Wanjiru halipika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wakati uliopita ukikanushwa, -li- hubadilika kuwa -ku-: alipika-hakupika.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Wanafunzi wanaimba."" Kwa nini "Wanafunzi hawakuimba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukanushaji huhifadhi wakati: uliopita hawakuimba, uliopo hawaimbi, ujao hawataimba.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni neno lipi limekanushwa?" Kwa nini "anasoma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Neno lililokanushwa linaonyesha kwamba kitendo hakifanyiki: hasomi, hakusoma, hatasoma.
